description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the detailed view of a Quote in the SugarCRM-based CRM system, including retrieving quote data, permissions, related lists, and rendering the Smarty template.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, providing instance retrieval and entity info methods.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: Handles session management for related list views.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Class for managing custom links in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record ID and module.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceNumber
methods.description: Gets the sequence number for the module record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence field for the module, if any.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for a specific action on a module record.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab/category of the current module.

methods.name: getDetailAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Fetches associated products for the quote.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks the status of buttons for the module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into arrays for processing.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related list information for the module.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for navigation.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules from the session.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Gets navigation info for list view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the Smarty template for the detail view.
